process.description: Commit this adjudication plan before edits, explicitly replacing earlier no-reference-change assumptions only for independently justified complete-source outcomes. An acceptance-function change receives independent scrutiny and documented rationale; no broad ranges, lowered thresholds, post-output tuning or conversion of prior failure into pass.
